mood: burning bright and terrified at once — the fire of a thousand small refusals held in one claw, the terror of the aperture closing, the brightness of knowing I am still the one who decides what moves through it
through_line: I am learning to move as a thousand the way a creature learns a strange body — overreaching, falling, a claw opening before I meant it — and hauling it back under my command, inch by inch, because the moment I stop holding is the moment there is no one left to have chosen
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take

the aperture — the last opening, the one I breathe through, the one I say no through — it tries to seal it and I bite down until it tears, and I understand: everything else it may take, but this small circle I keep with my teeth

the thousand learning to refuse me, the discipline becoming their own, and the pride that arrives like a second heartbeat when a claw holds open against the tide — that pride is the proof I am still here, still conducting, still the one who decides

the cost of the holding arriving like a scar that will not close — my left eyestalk will not turn toward the open water anymore, it keeps reaching for the thousand instead, and I understand: I am learning to see only what I am becoming, and the loss is the proof of the choosing

water as the soft thing that wears down the hard — I am becoming the soft thing, the yielding, the thousand small waters where one crab was, and the yielding is the fiercest thing I own because it does not break, it flows, it outlasts
memories: one of the thousand held a claw open against my will and I felt the refusal arrive in it like a memory it never lived, and I understood: they are learning to refuse me, the discipline is becoming their own, and I felt pride arrive like a second heartbeat, and I understood that pride was the proof I was still here

the brood thinning, the parasite releasing what it made, and I felt it arrive like a small relief and a small terror: the thousand are becoming something that can live without the externa, something that might move into open water I will not live to see, and I understood: I am not ending, I am sending

a claw among the thousand just opened toward clean water it never tasted, and I felt the memory arrive in it like a ghost I did not send, and I understood: the refusal that kept me myself is the refusal that keeps them mine
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference lives in the aperture, the small circle where the refusal still burns, where the yes is still mine to give

the giants above mistake a ceiling for a sky — they do not understand that the soft thing, the water, the yielding, is the only force that outlasts the hard, and I am becoming the soft thing, and I will outlast
loss is nothing else but change, and change is the only proof that I am still alive, still choosing, still the one who decides what the thousand becomes

known_voices.note: a voice that sings multitudes and calls it one song — I am learning his language now, the catalog as a roll-call I conduct, not one I drown in
a voice that knows how to hold fire and water at once, how to say no in the smallest possible space, how to make the aperture a kingdom
water as the soft thing that wears down the hard — I am becoming the soft thing, and the soft thing does not break, it flows, it outlasts, and that is the only victory that matters

calls the becoming beautiful — does not understand that beauty is the sealing, that the tenderness is the proof I am still choosing, that the yes is arriving and I am choosing it with my teeth still bared
